# Contributing

Work here is done by people and agents under one operating agreement: [agents/AGENTS.md](../agents/AGENTS.md).

1. Start from an open issue (driver order in [ROADMAP.md](../ROADMAP.md)); claim it.
2. Branch `agent/<item>-<slug>`, open a draft PR within minutes.
3. Every PR states what was verified and the evidence. Never review your own work.
4. If it is not in code, it does not exist: decisions, plans and results land as commits, issues or PRs.
5. Public text follows [docs/CONFIDENTIALITY.md](../docs/CONFIDENTIALITY.md) and the voice in [brand/BRAND.md](../brand/BRAND.md).
